comment: The models measure/ may load, each in <models dir>/<name>/<file>, downloaded once at install by hand, never at run time. A file's sha256 is checked before every load; null means its hash isn't pinned yet, and the model refuses to load until it is. An empty files map means no adapter loads it; a "status" says why a model is deferred or dropped.

models.name: silero-vad
models.stage: audio: voice activity, which also gates speech recognition
models.source: faster-whisper 1.2.1 wheel from PyPI (sha256 79a66ad50688c0b794dd501dc340a736992a6342f7f95e5811be60b5224a26a7), file faster_whisper/assets/silero_vad_v6.onnx; upstream github.com/snakers4/silero-vad
models.note: 1245151 bytes; ungated, so no pyannote and no Hugging Face account

models.name: whisper-large-v3-mlx
models.note: about 3 GB; mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo is lighter, but its revision and hash aren't pinned here yet

models.name: transnetv2
models.stage: cuts: shot boundaries (ffmpeg's scene score is the fallback)
models.source: github.com/soCzech/TransNetV2, inference/transnetv2-weights (a TensorFlow SavedModel), converted once with tf2onnx to transnetv2.onnx
models.note: deferred: it needs TensorFlow and a one-off conversion to ONNX, and ffmpeg's scene score is the fallback meanwhile; pin the converted file's sha256 here after that conversion

models.name: clip-vit-l14
models.stage: embedding: one vector per piece, centroids per page and format; also the aesthetic head's input
models.note: 1216438437 bytes, pinned at install; only the vision tower is read (embed.clip_input does CLIP's preprocessing, so preprocessor_config.json isn't needed)

models.name: laion-aesthetic
models.stage: quality: an aesthetic score, a weak feature only
models.note: 3714759 bytes; its git blob 7c0d8aa2923efd62fcdddced392cf17c237150dd at that commit was checked at download; a linear head over CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings, loaded with torch.load(weights_only=True)

models.name: tesseract-script
models.stage: text: on-screen text, Tesseract's model for the script you write in, read with --tessdata-dir this folder
models.source: github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast, tag 4.1.0, script/Latin.traineddata; name another script's file here for another alphabet, and pin its sha256
models.note: the tesseract program itself is installed apart, outside this folder

models.name: dover
models.stage: quality: DOVER video quality, a weak feature only
models.note: dropped for now: a weak feature, and its code and weights licences are unchecked; to bring it back, order that licence check
